name: Hikami Beniko
source:
The alluring, mysterious beauty.
A captivating woman with a mysterious air. Though she has a son with her businessman husband, her beauty and allure show no signs of fading. While helping with her family’s business, she also runs theaters and revues, proving herself to be a skilled entrepreneur.

"So smooth… what an absolutely adorable young lady you are."

[Translated from [url=https://pil-vamp.jp/products/aizou/chara]the official website[/url].]
